subject: Novato hosted pricing: monthly tokens & peak burst clarification
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novato.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick recap + hosted pricing ask

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the demo and the candid traffic breakdown today. Short recap and a couple quick asks so we can get a formal pricing sketch over to you: 

Summary from our side (please confirm):
- Core API usage: ~30M tokens/month (in-product realtime).
- Optional monthly enrichment/batch jobs: add ~60M tokens during campaign months (so campaign months could reach ~90M total).
- Steady-state months: ~35–40M tokens.
- Peak windows: short campaign bursts (≈10 minutes) where traffic concentrates — you mentioned spikes that could reach ~250–300 TPS for 3–5 minutes.
- Budget target: you indicated an internal budget reference around $750–$900 per 1M tokens. Please confirm a single target number if possible.

Questions / asks from Redwood:
1) Confirm the monthly baseline and campaign-month totals (30M baseline + 60M campaign = 90M) and whether the enrichment runs are optional or expected to be regular.
2) For the peak windows: are the 250–300 TPS spikes single-region only, or multi-region? Any tolerance for brief throttling?
3) Any procurement timing or contracting constraints we should know about?

I attached the Novato-MAP.xlsx we used in the call (traffic sketch + proposed MAP). If those numbers look right, we’ll run a quick unit-econ and propose two hosted-bands (committed + burst) and an optional dedicated offer for the tighter latency SLOs.

Next step: if you confirm the numbers, can we set a 30-min follow-up next week to review a pricing band and an ops playbook (warmups, burst gating)?

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachment: Novato-MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Elaine Park <elaine@novato.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam@novato.io>
Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + hosted pricing ask

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming / clarifying: 
- Core realtime product will be ~30M tokens/month.
- The enrichment runs are monthly and likely to add ~60M tokens during a campaign month (so ~90M total on those months) — campaigns are predictable (first week of every month) but duration/intensity can grow.
- Spikes are single-region for now (US east) but we may expand to EU later. Spikes happen as short windows — 8–12 minutes, with a ~3–4 minute peak. Peak TPS at the call was estimated 250–280 TPS; we should plan conservatively for 280 TPS.
- Budget: internally we’re targeting ~$800 per 1M tokens as a working number.

Two operational questions: 
1) What 99th percentile latency SLO can Redwood commit to on the hosted tier? We need to ensure the short spikes won’t push us over our UX threshold.
2) How do you tokenize the payloads? We send mostly short prompts (~30–70 tokens input, outputs vary). Any guidance on average tokens per call we should use for sizing?

If that all looks right to you, I’m happy to do the 30-min follow-up. Next week Tues/Wed afternoon PT works best for our team.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
VP Product, Novato
elaine@novato.io
Attachment: —
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Novato hosted pricing calc and ops notes

Internal only — quick calc and asks. Elaine confirmed baseline 30M + monthly campaigns that add 60M (90M campaign months). They want us to plan for 280 TPS short peaks (8–12 minute windows, with 3–4 minute hotpeak). Budget target $800 / 1M tokens.

Initial unit-econ sketch (back-of-envelope):
- Monthly tokens (campaign month): 90M tokens -> at $800 / 1M = $72,000/mo list.
- Baseline months (35M): at $850 / 1M ~ $29,750/mo if using committed band.
- Suggest we propose: committed band (50M @ $850/1M) + incremental hosted band up to 150M @ $750/1M for overage (gives them predictable bucket + cheaper incremental). That maps to about $42,500/mo committed + discounted incremental when they campaign.

Ops considerations / asks for Karthik:
- For 280 TPS short spikes, recommend we offer a burst credit mechanism + warm-up policy (pre-warm for campaign windows). Can you draft an ops playbook paragraph for burst gating and recommended warmup lead time (we should propose 30 minutes pre-warm)? Also confirm whether the hosted infra can reasonably hit 99th latency ~200–250ms under sustained high-concurrency for short windows; flag if we think dedicated is required to reach 150ms 99th.

Marissa — can you draft two price-band bullets (committed + incremental) and a one-pager showing monthly cost scenarios (baseline, campaign month, worst-case) and sample DocuSign-ready clause for burst credits? I’ll stitch and send to Elaine with a proposed follow-up slot.

Attachment: novato-pricing-tear-sheet.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novato.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + hosted pricing ask — proposal + next step

Hi Elaine — thanks for the fast confirmation. Based on what you confirmed, here’s a concise hosted proposal and suggested next steps: 

Numbers we used: baseline 30M/mo, campaign month 90M/mo, conservative peak 280 TPS in US-east for short windows. Target budget $800 / 1M.

Proposed hosted pricing (draft):
- Committed band: 50M tokens / month @ $850 per 1M tokens (billed monthly).
- Incremental hosted band: tokens above committed up to 150M @ $750 per 1M tokens.
- Campaign-month example: if Novato uses 90M tokens in a month, total invoice = (50M * $850/1M) + (40M * $750/1M) = $42,500 + $30,000 = $72,500.

Operational guarantees & options:
- Standard hosted SLO: 99th latency target ~250ms across typical prompt sizes (our baseline hosted performance).
- Premium hosted / Dedicated option: 99th latency target ~150ms (recommended if user-facing UX during peaks is critical).
- Burst handling: include 2 hours of monthly burst credits to smooth one-off spikes; for predictable monthly campaigns we recommend a 30-minute pre-warm window before the campaign batch and a short-term burst quota to avoid throttling.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, let’s book a 30-min technical + ops sync (I’ll include Karthik and our infra lead) — you suggested Tue/Wed afternoon PT next week; I’ll send a scheduler in a separate email.
2) Marissa will attach the one-pager cost scenarios and the DocuSign-ready draft.

Attached: hosting-options.pdf (summary of hosted vs dedicated options). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/9832

If you want a single $/1M target, we can lean the incremental band toward your $800 target (e.g., 50M @ $875 + incremental @ $800) — happy to model which approach keeps you under procurement thresholds.

Thanks — talk soon,
Markus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com
